messages:
Tess (Docs): opened draft PR to update Vesper7b model card + catalog row. Key changes: clarify supported memory tiers, add a short note on 16k vs 32k streaming behavior, correct quant compatibility table, and swap in new streaming SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5010 please quick-review for wording and any ops caveats.

Mason (Bench): added bench numbers in PR comments. Quick summary: 130-170 tok/s on A10 (batch=1, seq=4k), 45-70 tok/s on T4 (batch=1, seq=4k). These vary a lot with prompt shape and cold-starts. I'll attach the exact harness and docker tag.

Yara (Runtime): two runtime notes: 1) our runtime label is "vesper7b-q4_k_m" for the quant profile; please use that in the compatibility table to avoid confusion. 2) we have an automatic fallback to "vesper7b-fp16" when the quant kernels are unavailable on some hosts; recommend mentioning fallback behavior and how users can pin to a variant.

Tess (Docs): good catches. I'll change labels to the runtime names and add a sentence about fp16 fallback + a short snippet showing how to pin.

Elena (PM): avoid marketing superlatives. Also add a short rollback note for Dedicated customers (how to pin a model variant for a canary). Keep the public-facing throughput a range and qualify with test config.

Sam (DevEx): updated the python + TS examples in the PR to use streaming and to show detecting fallback via the stream metadata. Python example in thread:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.generate_stream(prompt, model='vesper7b-q4_k_m'):
    if chunk.meta.get('runtime_fallback'):
        # log fallback and surface to customer
        print('\n[fallback to fp16]')
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Can someone confirm meta key name?

Yara (Runtime): meta key is runtime_fallback (boolean) and runtime_variant (string). those names are fine. Also suggest adding how to detect a soft-degraded latency event via the trace id in the stream.

Mason (Bench): also suggest including a short note on batching effects: batching can improve throughput but increases p95 latency; we should link to the batching guidance doc.

ci-bot: docs-ci/pr-check: failed  markdown-lint: duplicate-anchor-id in supported-variants table. See https://ci.redwood.dev/1301

Tess (Docs): fixing anchors now and swapping the internal runtime link to the public runtime-mapping page. Re-requesting review after push.

ci-bot: docs-ci/pr-check: passed on second run :white_check_mark:

Elena (PM): LGTM from PM. Tess please include a one-sentence migration note for customers who previously referenced the legacy name "vesper7b" without variant suffix.

Tess (Docs): will add migration sentence and merge in ~10m unless anyone objects. I'll post a short summary in #docs-release after merge. "Thanks!"
